properties.name: wallet.rp.id
properties.description: WebAuthn Relying Party ID. Must match the registered domain in production (e.g., wpb.diswallet.eu).

properties.name: wallet.rp.name
properties.description: Human-readable name of the Relying Party shown during WebAuthn ceremonies.

properties.name: wallet.origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed WebAuthn origins. Use HTTPS only in production.

properties.name: wallet.allow-untrusted-attestation
properties.description: Allow unverified authenticator attestation. Must be false in production with MDS configured.

properties.name: wallet.challenge.ttl-seconds
properties.description: Time-to-live in seconds for a WebAuthn challenge before it expires.

properties.name: wallet.disclosures.encryption-key
properties.description: Base64-encoded AES-256 key used to encrypt SD-JWT disclosures at rest.

properties.name: wpb.hsm.library
properties.description: Path to the PKCS#11 library file used by the HSM (e.g., /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so).

properties.name: wpb.hsm.pin
properties.description: PIN code for HSM authentication. Should be externalized via environment variable HSM_PIN in production.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.demo-mode
properties.description: Enables demo-only OpenID4VP fallback paths for the local verifier emulator. Never enable in production.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.allowed-client-ids
properties.description: Comma-separated allow-list of accepted verifier client_id values. When empty, trust validation is permissive (Phase 1 baseline only).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.source-mode
properties.description: Trust source mode for verifier authentication: file | remote | hybrid.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.local-verifiers-path
properties.description: Optional path (classpath:/ or file) to JSON trusted verifier definitions.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.local-trust-anchor-pem-paths
properties.description: Comma-separated local PEM trust anchor paths (classpath:/ or file).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.remote-trust-url
properties.description: Optional remote URL returning trust snapshot JSON.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.remote-allowed-hosts
properties.description: Comma-separated remote trust hosts allowed in production mode (demo mode may be permissive).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.remote-refresh-interval-seconds
properties.description: Background refresh interval for remote trust source in seconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.remote-connect-timeout-ms
properties.description: Remote trust source HTTP connect timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.remote-read-timeout-ms
properties.description: Remote trust source HTTP read timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.max-snapshot-age-seconds
properties.description: Maximum accepted age for cached trust snapshot in seconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.allow-fail-open-in-demo-mode
properties.description: Allow fail-open on trust source outage only when demo-mode is enabled.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.enabled
properties.description: Enable TS5/TS6 RP registry validation during presentation flow.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.specification-version
properties.description: Registry API specification version reference for observability and audit.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for TS5 RP registry endpoints.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.remote-allowed-hosts
properties.description: Comma-separated allow-list of registry hosts accepted in production.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.connect-timeout-ms
properties.description: Registry HTTP connect timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.read-timeout-ms
properties.description: Registry HTTP read timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.max-cache-age-seconds
properties.description: Maximum age of cached registry entries in seconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.verification-key-pem-paths
properties.description: Comma-separated paths to PEM public keys/certs used to verify TS5 response JWS signatures.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.require-signed-responses
properties.description: Require signed registry read responses (application/jwt JWS).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.require-signed-envelope-fields
properties.description: Require TS5 envelope fields iss/iat/data in signed payload.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.allowed-issuers
properties.description: Comma-separated allow-list for accepted JWT iss claim values.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.expected-audience
properties.description: Optional expected JWT audience for registry responses.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.clock-skew-seconds
properties.description: Allowed skew in seconds for JWT temporal claim checks.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.registry.prefer-check-intended-use-endpoint
properties.description: Prefer /wrp/check-intended-use over local intended use inference when available.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.session.ttl-seconds
properties.description: Presentation session time-to-live in seconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.demo-mode
properties.description: Activates the in-process simulated OID4VCI adapter. Disable for real SDK integration.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.session-ttl-seconds
properties.description: Issuance session time-to-live in seconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.trust.allowed-issuer-ids
properties.description: Comma-separated allow-list of credential issuer identifiers.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.policy.allow-mdoc
properties.description: Allow mso_mdoc credential configurations behind policy gate.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.simulator.always-defer
properties.description: Force every simulated credential request into a deferred outcome.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.simulator.deferred-polls-before-issue
properties.description: Number of deferred polls before the simulator returns issued credentials.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.credential-issuer-id
properties.description: Hint for the credential issuer identifier when the real SDK adapter is active.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.dpop-mode
properties.description: DPoP support mode: supported | required | disabled.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.metadata-policy
properties.description: Issuer metadata policy: preferSigned | requireSigned | ignoreSigned.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.pkce-required
properties.description: Enforce PKCE for authorization-code grants (always true).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.use-par-when-supported
properties.description: Send authorization requests via PAR when the issuer advertises it.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.strict-resolution
properties.description: Require SDK resolver success and disable local fallback parsing for the real adapter.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.enabled
properties.description: Enable WIA sub-context processing in issuance flows.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.token-ttl-seconds
properties.description: WIA JWT technical TTL in seconds (must remain under 24 hours).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.min-status-maintenance-days
properties.description: Minimum client_status maintenance period in days.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.reuse-per-issuer
properties.description: Reuse WIA status list entry per issuer (default false for privacy).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.wallet-name
properties.description: Wallet solution name claim included in WIA.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.wallet-version
properties.description: Wallet solution version claim included in WIA.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.wallet-link
properties.description: Optional URI with further wallet solution information.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.wallet-solution-certification-information
properties.description: Certification information claim for the wallet solution.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.signing-x5c
properties.description: Optional raw x5c value embedded in WIA header (MVP transport only).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.max-nonce-mismatch-retries
properties.description: Maximum retries when authorization fails due to nonce mismatch.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.max-expired-retries
properties.description: Maximum retries when WIA is expired during authorization.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.enabled
properties.description: Enable KA processing for device-bound issuance.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.token-ttl-seconds
properties.description: KA JWT technical TTL in seconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.min-status-maintenance-days
properties.description: Minimum key_storage_status maintenance horizon in days.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.reuse-per-issuer
properties.description: Reuse KA per issuer (default false for privacy).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.key-storage
properties.description: TS3 key_storage claim value.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.user-authentication
properties.description: TS3 user_authentication claim value.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.certification-scheme
properties.description: Certification scheme used in KA payload.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.certification-assurance-level
properties.description: Certification assurance level in KA payload.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.certification-info
properties.description: Certification details included in KA payload.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.issuer
properties.description: Issuer identifier used in KA claims.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.signing-x5c
properties.description: Optional x5c chain in KA header (comma-separated DER base64 values or PEM blocks).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.require-x5c
properties.description: Require x5c in key attestation trust validation.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.allowed-x5c-fingerprints
properties.description: Comma-separated allow-list of accepted attestation certificate fingerprints.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.trust-mode
properties.description: Trust mode for KA x5c validation (`relaxed` or `strict`).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.ka.trust-anchor-pem-paths
properties.description: Comma-separated file/classpath paths for PEM trust anchors used in strict mode.
